mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.code, a.name, a.maintainer, a.maintaintime, a.address, a.country, a.province, a.industry, a.contact, a.contactphone, a.longitude, a.latitude, a.note, a.delflag, a.defaultlang, a.creator, a.createtime, a.scode, a.3rdflag, a.version, a.datagettype, a.status, a.city, a.expiredate, a.industrysize, a.purchaseperiod, a.filename, a.aliasname, a.effectdate FROM biz_base_factory a
and a.id = #{id}
and a.code like concat('%',#{code}, '%')
and a.name like concat('%',#{name}, '%')
and a.maintainer like concat('%',#{maintainer}, '%')
and a.maintaintime >= concat(#{maintaintimefrom}, ' 00:00:00')
and a.maintaintime <= concat(#{maintaintimeto}, ' 23:59:59')
and a.address like concat('%',#{address}, '%')
and a.country like concat('%',#{country}, '%')
and a.province like concat('%',#{province}, '%')
and a.industry like concat('%',#{industry}, '%')
and a.contact like concat('%',#{contact}, '%')
and a.contactphone like concat('%',#{contactphone}, '%')
and a.longitude like concat('%',#{longitude}, '%')
and a.latitude like concat('%',#{latitude}, '%')
and a.note like concat('%',#{note}, '%')
and a.delflag like concat('%',#{delflag}, '%')
and a.defaultlang like concat('%',#{defaultlang}, '%')
and a.creator like concat('%',#{creator}, '%')
and a.createtime >= concat(#{createtimefrom}, ' 00:00:00')
and a.createtime <= concat(#{createtimeto}, ' 23:59:59')
and a.scode like concat('%',#{scode}, '%')
and a.3rdflag like concat('%',#{3rdflag}, '%')
and a.version like concat('%',#{version}, '%')
and a.datagettype like concat('%',#{datagettype}, '%')
and a.status = #{status}
and a.city like concat('%',#{city}, '%')
and a.expiredate >= concat(#{expiredatefrom}, ' 00:00:00')
and a.expiredate <= concat(#{expiredateto}, ' 23:59:59')
and a.industrysize like concat('%',#{industrysize}, '%')
and a.purchaseperiod like concat('%',#{purchaseperiod}, '%')
and a.filename like concat('%',#{filename}, '%')
and a.aliasname like concat('%',#{aliasname}, '%')
and a.effectdate >= concat(#{effectdatefrom}, ' 00:00:00')
and a.effectdate <= concat(#{effectdateto}, ' 23:59:59')
